description: What a fund or institutional manager owns, from its latest SEC 13F-HR filing: give a name (Berkshire Hathaway, Bridgewater) or CIK. Holdings ranked by value with issuer, CUSIP, shares, value and portfolio weight, total value and top-10 concentration, plus changes since the previous quarter: new positions, sold out, added and trimmed with share change. Data: SEC EDGAR. Managers with very large filings (Vanguard, BlackRock) answer 422. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
